title: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya - God Knows
description:
This is God Knows from the fairly well-known anime The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya. This is the full version, so I honestly don't expect this to actually go through the submission process due to the absolute sheer size of it, but well, I might as well try really lol; if it doesn't go through, just PM me for the port and I'll give you the .zip file if you want it

Anyway, I really don't see this being fitting for anything but ending/credit themes since the size fits a scenario like this the most, but I still have looped the song if for some odd reason you actually want to use this on a level; just be aware it probably won't fit the situation very well lmao
